evidence_concerns: Headline performance tables are located (Results 3.1, Tables 3-4: held-out 80/20-split classifier comparison on 497 variants; Results 3.3, Table 6: external validation on 11,932 ClinVar variants) but no numeric cell was transcribed from them this pass.
